description: Prerequisite: caller holds admin rights. Effect: sends ModerationRequest{IPBAN_USER, EntityId=target_persist_id} on the city socket. Like ban-user (sets fso_users.is_banned=1 on target) plus adds an fso_bans row for the target's last_ip (unless loopback 127.0.0.1/::1). Cost: none. Persistent DB mutation on two tables. No response PDU. Non-admin callers refused in the bot handler.

args.name: target_persist_id
args.description: avatar_id (Sim persist id) of the user to IP-ban.

call_signatures: cf $CF ipban-user --target_persist_id <avatar_id>                                    # admin-only; ban + fso_bans row for last IP
common_mistakes: IPBAN does NOT add an fso_bans row when target's last IP is loopback — quiet no-op on localhost traffic.
perception_hints: Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id (for physically-present targets); other avatars need find-avatar or direct knowledge of avatar_id
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-target): perception.avatar.persist_id
Chat activity you may want to moderate: perception.recent_events[] kind=='chat'
